messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — want to lock owners + delivery dates for the remediation tickets before EOD. Observed a recurring spike pattern on weekend deploys; we should assign a long-term owner.

maria: +1. I can take the deploy-safety checklist work if everyone's ok. will create the Jira and link it to the PM.

kevin: thanks. can we split the work into (1) short-term hotfix, (2) rollout safeguards, (3) monitoring/regression eval? easier to track.

alex: yep that's the plan. short-term hotfix = `RW-5274`, rollout safeguards = `RW-5275`, monitoring/evals = `RW-5276`. i'll add the RACI notes to each ticket.

maria: created `RW-5275` and `RW-5276`. added initial checklist and labeled them `postmortem-action` + `recurring-pattern`. ticket links: https://jira.redwood/RW-5275 https://jira.redwood/RW-5276

sophia: i'm happy to own monitoring/evals (`RW-5276`). will set up an eval suite for the weekend deploy workload and add alert thresholds. target: prototype by next Wed.

kevin: i'll own the hotfix `RW-5274` — ETA tomorrow morning. will post short PR and a canary plan.

alex: RACI quick callout: R=kevin (hotfix), A=maria (rollout safeguards), C=sophia (metrics/evals), I=oncall-bot + infra-eng. I'll paste a tiny table into each ticket.

alex: RACI snippet to paste:```R: kevin
A: maria
C: sophia, infra-eng
I: oncall-bot, product-ops```

maria: also adding a handoff step: once hotfix is merged, oncall should validate for 24h, then owner rotates to rollout team for post-deploy checklist. added `handoff: oncall -> rollout` in RW-5275.

oncall-bot: Incident bot notice: RW-5274 marked `hotfix-in-progress` by kevin at 2024-06-12T09:10Z.

kevin: PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/3192. includes canary script. asking @maria for rollout signoff once CI passes.

alex: timeline recap: hotfix (kevin) - tomorrow AM; rollout safeguards (maria) - 2 weeks; monitoring/evals (sophia) - next Wed prototype, full eval in 3 weeks. if any dates slip, call it out here and update Jira.

maria: noted — i'll add assignees + due dates in RW-5275 tonight. also created a follow-up recurring ticket to check for similar spikes monthly: `RW-5280`.

kevin: one more: can we add an explicit rollback play in RW-5275? I hit a minor rollback gap in the postmortem.

alex: good catch. adding `rollback-play` to RW-5275 tasks.

kevin: ✅ updated the PR with rollback steps.

sophia: tagging monitoring owners in RW-5276 and RW-5280. will post a short eval doc by EOD Monday.

alex: thanks team. Action owners summary (copy to Jira): `RW-5274: kevin (R) due 2024-06-13`, `RW-5275: maria (A) due 2024-06-26`, `RW-5276: sophia (C) prototype due 2024-06-19`, `RW-5280: infra-eng (I) recurring checks monthly`. If no objections I'll close this thread tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria: sounds good. :+1:

kevin: no objections.

sophia: all good from my side.
